projects.title: Polish. Book proofreading plus corrections, additions, rephrasing, rewriting + proofreading and editing
projects.full_description:
Language accuracy: correct spelling, punctuation, and grammar errors.

Typography: replace hyphens with dashes; check that quotation marks are used correctly («guillemets» instead of “inch marks”). REMOVE ellipses, repeated characters, and technical clutter: clean the text of excess marks such as ???, !!!, ......., №, %, #, *, and the like. An audiobook narrator will not be able to read them properly — or will read them, but they are unnecessary.

Consistency: the same forms of names (Masha/Maria), numerals, dates, and abbreviations throughout the text.

List formatting: a single standard for bullets, periods, and capitalization in enumerations. One font, one size.

Highlight changes in color: anything you change must be marked so I can later compare it with the original text.

Semantic coherence: check that characters’ motives are clear, assumptions are justified, and all plot arcs are completed. There must be no dropped thought or break in a clear storyline. After AI review, awkward robotic phrases and sentences remain that no person would say: the thought gets lost or cuts off, word order is wrong, invented slang and unclear abbreviations appear. These must be fixed. It is important to write clearly, in Polish.

Structure and architecture: every chapter must contain at least something interesting — a chapter cannot be empty. A single chapter must not be overloaded with events.

Stylistic editing: remove tautology, bureaucratic phrasing, and unnecessary filler.

Break long sentences (3–4 lines) into shorter ones. The narrator will physically run out of breath, and the listener will lose the thread of the story by the end of the phrase. (Required for the audiobook.)

Do not submit work in which I then have to hunt for mistakes and spend time explaining what to fix and where. YOU ARE THE FINAL INSTANCE. After you, the text goes to print. SUBMIT THE WORK IN DOCX FORMAT. Make titles and subtitles bold.

projects.full_description:
Full-Stack Developer Needed – Add Inventory & Order Management Module to Existing Web System
Project Overview

I am looking for an experienced full-stack developer to develop and integrate a new Inventory & Order Management module into an existing web-based system that is currently being developed by another freelancer.

This is NOT a project to build a completely new system from scratch.

We already have an existing web application, codebase, database and hosting environment. I want the new developer to review the existing system and determine the best way to integrate the new module into it.

The existing system is currently built using:

[login to view URL]
React
TypeScript
Supabase / PostgreSQL
Tailwind CSS
GitHub
Node.js
VPS hosting

The existing developer has provided technical documentation covering the current code structure, GitHub repository, VPS and technology stack. I can provide this documentation to shortlisted candidates.

What I Need

I am looking for a simple, clean and easy-to-use inventory system for managing our physical trophy stock.

The basic concept is:

Record incoming stock
See current available stock
Deduct stock when items are taken for production
Temporarily place stock "On Hold" for potential customer orders
Convert confirmed orders into actual orders
Track basic order information and payment status
See who performed each stock movement
Have a clear dashboard showing the overall inventory situation

The system should be designed for normal office staff who are not technically trained, so simplicity and ease of use are very important.

I am not looking for a complicated ERP or accounting system.
Dashboard & UI/UX

The system should have a clean dashboard where management/staff can immediately understand the current stock situation.

For example, we would like to have an overview such as:

Total Stock | Available | On Hold | Low Stock | Out of Stock

The exact layout and design are open to your recommendation.

I have not used many inventory systems before, so I would appreciate a developer who can also provide good UI/UX recommendations, rather than simply building whatever is technically easiest.

The interface should be:

Clean
Modern
Simple
Uncluttered
Easy to read at a glance
Easy for staff to navigate
Integration With Existing System

This is an important part of the project.

The new module should ideally integrate with the existing system rather than operate as a separate application.

The selected developer will first need to review the existing codebase and advise:

Whether the inventory module can be integrated cleanly
Whether the existing database can be extended
Whether the existing login/user system can be reused
How the new module should fit into the existing application
Whether there are any technical risks or concerns

The existing system should not be negatively affected by the new development.
Existing System & Backup

Before making any changes to the live system, I want the existing code and database properly backed up and the development work carried out safely.

The developer should be comfortable working with:

GitHub
Existing codebases
Database backups
Development/staging environments
VPS deployment

I would like the freelancer to explain their recommended approach for protecting the existing system before development begins.
Previous Work / Portfolio – Important

I would like to see actual examples of systems you have previously developed, particularly:

Inventory systems
Stock management systems
Order management systems
Business management dashboards
Similar web applications

Please provide screenshots, videos, demos or portfolio links where possible.

I am particularly interested in seeing the UI/dashboard design of systems you have previously built.

I have not used a dedicated inventory system before, so seeing your previous work will help me understand what is possible and what design approach you would recommend.

projects.title: Short-Form Video Editor for Social Media
projects.full_description:
We’re looking for a skilled Short-Form Video Editor who understands that great short-form content is about more than just making videos look good. You should have a strong sense of hooks, pacing, retention, storytelling, and what makes people stop scrolling and keep watching.

We will provide the raw footage, and your job will be to turn it into engaging 15–60 second vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts.

You’ll be responsible for producing a minimum of 5 finished videos per week, with the opportunity to scale the volume over time. For every video, we also want two genuinely different opening hooks so we can test which approach performs better.

What You’ll Do
Edit 15–60 second vertical short-form videos
Create at least 5 finished videos per week
Develop two different hooks for each video
Improve retention through pacing, structure, and storytelling
Add captions, B-roll, graphics, music, sound effects, and pattern interrupts when useful
Adapt videos appropriately for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts
Maintain a consistent visual style across content
Review performance metrics after videos are published
Identify patterns between high-performing and low-performing content
Use performance data to improve future hooks, pacing, and editing decisions
Test different creative approaches, messages, and formats
Keep footage, project files, versions, and final assets properly organized
What We’re Looking For

A short-form video portfolio is required. We are specifically looking for someone experienced with performance-driven social content rather than someone focused primarily on cinematic or long-form editing.

You should have:

Proven experience editing TikToks, Reels, Shorts, or similar vertical content
Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and short-form storytelling
Good knowledge of current social media editing styles and formats
Ability to create different hooks from the same raw footage
Strong instincts for what keeps viewers watching
Understanding of metrics such as watch time, retention, completion rate, shares, saves, and engagement
Ability to analyze why a video performed well or poorly
Fast turnaround without sacrificing quality
Strong attention to detail
Ability to take feedback and make quick iterations
Good file and project organization
Genuine interest in understanding why certain content performs better than other content

You should also actively consume short-form content and have a good understanding of what is currently working across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

Bonus Experience

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

DIY or home improvement content
Consumer education or technology
DTC brands
Educational or explainer videos
Performance marketing creative
Repurposing organic content into paid social advertisements
How We Measure Success

This role is not simply about producing more videos. We want to build a content process that improves over time.

We’ll be looking at questions such as:

Which hook kept people watching?
Where are viewers dropping off?
Which edits improve retention?
What makes people share or save a video?
Which formats generate stronger engagement?
Which videos drive audience growth?
What should we change in the next edit?

Performance will be evaluated through content output, retention, watch time, engagement, audience growth, and the ability to identify and improve winning creative concepts.

Compensation

This is a remote position. We are open to different compensation structures, including:

Per-video payment
Monthly retainer
Contract engagement

The required editing software and tools can be provided.

For the right person, there is potential for a long-term or full-time opportunity as the content operation grows. Additional performance-based bonuses may also be available for exceptional results.

How to Apply

Please include the following with your application:

3–5 examples of short-form videos you personally edited
Links to published videos when available
Performance metrics for your work, if available
A brief explanation of how you determine whether a short-form video performed well or poorly
Your typical turnaround time
Your preferred compensation structure

projects.title: Edit Thesis Methodology & Results
projects.full_description:
Feedback from Professor,
Thank you for sending me the revised version of your thesis. I have now reviewed Chapters 3, 4 and 5 and added my comments directly to the document.
Overall, the empirical analysis is well structured and the main results are clearly presented. However, before preparing the final version, there is one point that I consider particularly important and that I would like you to address carefully.
Since your research question explicitly compares the explanatory role of commodity prices with that of global financial conditions, you need to provide a more rigorous basis for this comparison. In particular, please report standardized beta coefficients for the regressors.
At present, some statements about the US dollar index being the “strongest” variable appear to rely partly on the magnitude of the raw OLS coefficients. Since the regressors have different variances, these coefficients cannot be directly compared in terms of relative importance.
Standardized beta coefficients allow the effects of the different regressors to be compared on a common scale. (I have included instructions in the Word document on how to calculate them.)
Please report these coefficients, briefly interpret them, and revise expressions such as “strongest”, “dominates”, or “greater explanatory power” accordingly.
I have also included a number of smaller comments in the document, which I would ask you to address when revising the final version. More generally, I would suggest slightly softening the tone of the conclusions, especially when comparing the relative importance of commodity prices and global financial conditions. Try to avoid overly assertive statements and make sure that the wording of the conclusions closely reflects what can be supported by the empirical results.


Overall, I think this is a good piece of work, and addressing these final points will further strengthen the thesis and make the conclusions more robust.

projects.full_description:
# Full-Time Accounting & Reconciliation Professional – Travel Business

### Project Overview

We are a growing travel business dealing in **airline ticket inventory and insurance products**. We pre-purchase airline inventory and resell it through our platform.

We are looking for an experienced **Accounting & Reconciliation Professional** who can take complete ownership of our day-to-day accounting operations, Tally management, inventory accounting and financial reconciliation.

This is a **long-term, full-time engagement**. We are looking for someone who can independently manage the accounting function rather than someone who only performs basic data entry.

### Key Responsibilities

* Maintain and manage complete accounting in **Tally**
* Daily/regular **Bank Reconciliation** for all bank accounts
* **Credit Card Reconciliation**
* Reconciliation of airline/vendor payments and outstanding balances
* Reconciliation of **airline inventory purchased vs. sold**
* Track inventory balances, purchases, sales, cancellations, refunds and adjustments
* Reconcile booking/sales data between our travel platform and accounting records
* Manage customer/vendor ledgers and outstanding balances
* Proper accounting of airline ticket purchases and resales
* Handle accounting entries related to **airline inventory**
* Reconcile payment gateway / collection accounts wherever applicable
* Identify mismatches, missing entries and unexplained transactions
* Maintain proper supporting records for all transactions
* Monthly closing and reconciliation of accounts
* Generate regular MIS/accounting reports
* Coordinate with management/CA for required financial and tax-related information
* Keep Tally books clean, accurate and up to date

### Software / System Knowledge Required

**Mandatory:**

* Strong knowledge of **Tally**
* Advanced accounting and reconciliation skills
* Excellent Excel/Google Sheets skills
* Experience handling large transaction volumes

**Highly Preferred:**

* Experience with **EasyLink / travel agency accounting systems**
* Experience in **travel agency / airline ticketing accounting**
* Experience with airline inventory accounting
* Experience with B2B/B2C travel businesses
* Understanding of airline ticket sales, refunds, cancellations and inventory reconciliation

### Ideal Candidate

We are NOT looking for a basic bookkeeper or data-entry operator.

We need someone who can take ownership of the complete accounting process and say:

**“Give me the bank statements, credit card statements, sales data, purchase data and Tally — I will reconcile everything and keep the books accurate.”**

The candidate should be:

* Experienced and independent
* Detail-oriented
* Strong in reconciliation
* Comfortable handling high transaction volumes
* Able to identify accounting discrepancies independently
* Good at Excel and data analysis
* Familiar with travel/airline business accounting
* Available for a **full-time engagement**
* Looking for a long-term association

### Engagement

**Type:** Full-Time / Long-Term
**Work:** Accounting + Reconciliation + Tally Management
**Industry:** Travel / Airline Ticketing / Insurance
**Working Model:** Remote
**Experience:** Preferably 3+ years in accounting, with relevant travel-industry experience preferred

### To Apply

Please share:

1. Your total accounting experience
2. Your experience with Tally
3. Your experience with bank & credit card reconciliation
4. Whether you have worked with **EasyLink**
5. Whether you have worked with a **travel agency / airline ticketing company**
6. Experience handling high-volume transactions
7. Your expected monthly remuneration
8. Your availability for full-time work
9. Briefly describe a similar accounting/reconciliation project you have handled

**Important:** Please apply only if you have hands-on experience in accounting and reconciliation and can independently manage the complete accounting workflow.

I’d like to get this wrapped up quickly, so let me know your turnaround time and any previous work with short fiction or similar creative pieces.
